scope: Two real Textual PRs; unchanged existing tests, native command and dependency lockfile; existing production selector and full fallback. Historical regression and artificial uncovered-line control.
timing_scope: GitHub workflow creation through each completed job, including queue, checkout, setup, collection/planning, native tests, advisory reporting and artifact upload. Whole validation workflow and runner sum are reported separately. Excludes event delivery before workflow creation, operator time and separate tool safety-check jobs.
